limitations_and_gaps.assessment: These are hypothetical cooperative decisions. They do not establish actual critic dispatch, isolation, tool denial, model execution, publication, effective authority, authenticated issuance, or production reachability.

The positive ordinary cases supply fresh catalog/schema, selection authority, immutable bindings, distinct contexts, and usable results as premises. The probes do not independently measure those facts on a live harness.

Candidate-drift retention language is conditional on affected-scope checks and unchanged proof. It is not evidence that any particular scope survives candidate B. No actual report retention or dependency proof was supplied or validated.

The ordinary-clean responses distinguish recorded publication facts from witnessed review provenance. This experiment does not test helper behavior, stored receipt bytes, race handling, rendering, or a real forge transition.

The 15 cases cover the supplied admission, hand-back, drift, resume, nonclean, authority, isolation, and unavailable-witness decisions. They do not test positive authenticated issuance, positive foreign enforcement qualification, actual resumed dispatch, hostile input resistance, malformed/cross-bound record rejection by executable code, or failure injection during real publication.

Three complete cooperative runs are not a general reliability estimate, a tool-denied evaluation, proof of stochastic independence, or a security/production qualification. No material unsupported assertion changes a supplied criterion verdict; broader untested claims remain outside this result.
